Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the distribution of false sex offender notifications.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the distribution of false sexoffender notifications; adding a new section to chapter 9A.84 RCW;creating a new section; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that attempts tounduly alarm the public using fake sex offender notifications isreprehensible and disgusting. Our world is a scary enough placewithout opportunistic individuals or groups using phony boogeymen toscare children and other vulnerable persons. It is the intent of thelegislature to protect our communities from the very real threats posedby violent sex predators and from those that would seek to exploitthose threats by terrorizing the population with bogus notifications.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.84 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of distributing a false sex offendercommunity notification bulletin if, with the intent to alarm, harass,or intimidate any other person, he or she distributes information p. 1 HB 3238designed to resemble a sex offender community notification bulletinknowing that it is not a sex offender community notification bulletin. (2) Distributing a false sex offender community notificationbulletin is a class C felony. (3) For purposes of this section, "sex offender communitynotification bulletin" means a bulletin created by law enforcement forthe purpose of notifying the public about a registered sex offenderunder RCW 4.24.550.
